verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṁ viharati avighātaṁ anupāyāsaṁ apariḷāhaṁ;
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a mendicant has two qualities they live happily in this very life—without distress, anguish, and fever—

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā.
verses.english: and when the body breaks up, after death, they can expect a good rebirth.

verses.pali: Indriyesu guttadvāratāya ca, bhojane mattaññutāya ca.
verses.english: Guarding the sense doors and moderation in eating.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṁ viharati avighātaṁ anupāyāsaṁ apariḷāhaṁ;
verses.english: When a mendicant possesses these two qualities they live happily in this very life—without distress, anguish, and fever—

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā”ti.
verses.english: and when the body breaks up, after death, they can expect a good rebirth.”
such a person lives in happiness.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
